--!strict
-- Shared authored times for sprint-cut.md (61 source frames / 2 seconds).
-- Marker callbacks advance gameplay; these times validate/order intent, never fabricate a strike.
local Timeline = {}
Timeline.Duration = 2.0
Timeline.TrapAt = 0.1333
Timeline.StrikeAt = 0.2667
Timeline.ReleaseAt = 0.6667
Timeline.BlendOutAt = 1.8
Timeline.TrapDistance = 2.55
Timeline.PushLead = 0.45
Timeline.EarlyTolerance = 0.08
Timeline.LateTolerance = 0.35
Timeline.SprintGraceSec = 0.12

export type Profile = { TrapFoot: string, StrikeFoot: string }
local left = table.freeze({ TrapFoot = "L", StrikeFoot = "L" })
local right = table.freeze({ TrapFoot = "R", StrikeFoot = "R" })
local profiles: { [string]: Profile } = {
	FrontLeft = left, FrontRight = right, BackLeft = left, BackRight = right,
	-- Existing reversal bindings share one left-pivot clip.
	ReverseLeft = left, ReverseRight = left,
}

function Timeline.Get(cut: string): Profile?
	return profiles[cut]
end

function Timeline.HasSprintContext(active: boolean, lastSprintAt: number?, now: number): boolean
	return active or (lastSprintAt ~= nil and now >= lastSprintAt and now - lastSprintAt <= Timeline.SprintGraceSec)
end

function Timeline.ValidateMarker(profile: Profile, phase: any, foot: any, elapsed: number): boolean
	if elapsed ~= elapsed or math.abs(elapsed) == math.huge then return false end
	local time: number
	local expectedFoot: string
	if phase == "Trap" then
		time, expectedFoot = Timeline.TrapAt, profile.TrapFoot
	elseif phase == "Strike" then
		time, expectedFoot = Timeline.StrikeAt, profile.StrikeFoot
	elseif phase == "Release" then
		time, expectedFoot = Timeline.ReleaseAt, profile.StrikeFoot
	else
		return false
	end
	return foot == expectedFoot and elapsed >= time - Timeline.EarlyTolerance and elapsed <= time + Timeline.LateTolerance
end

function Timeline.DirectionAlpha(time: number): number
	local t = math.clamp((time - Timeline.StrikeAt) / (Timeline.ReleaseAt - Timeline.StrikeAt), 0, 1)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

function Timeline.SpeedFactor(time: number): number
	if time < Timeline.TrapAt then
		local t = math.clamp(time / Timeline.TrapAt, 0, 1)
		return 1 - 0.55 * t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
	elseif time < Timeline.StrikeAt then
		return 0.45
	end
	return 0.45 + 0.55 * Timeline.DirectionAlpha(time)
end

return table.freeze(Timeline)

--!strict
-- src/client/character/DribbleClipData.luau
-- Immutable Authored R15 Dribble, Directional Cut, and G-Mode Close-Control Animation Data
-- Governed by RF02-DRIBBLE-ANIMATION-INTEGRATION Contract (2026-10-27).
-- Provides deterministic KeyframeSequence construction with 15 R15 joints and KeyframeMarkers.

local CutTimeline = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("DribbleCutTimeline"))
local SprintCutReference = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SprintCutReferenceData"))
local WalkDribbleReference = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WalkDribbleReferenceData"))

export type MarkerEntry = {
	t: number,
	name: string,
	value: string,
}

export type JointSample = {
	p: Vector3?,
	r: Vector3,
}

export type PoseMap = { [string]: JointSample }

export type ClipDefinition = {
	name: string,
	duration: number,
	keyCount: number,
	loop: boolean,
	priority: Enum.AnimationPriority,
	markers: { MarkerEntry },
	frameTimes: { number }?,
	poseAt: (u: number) -> PoseMap,
}

local R15_TREE = {
	name = "HumanoidRootPart",
	children = {
		{
			name = "LowerTorso",
			children = {
				{
					name = "UpperTorso",
					children = {
						{ name = "Head", children = {} },
						{ name = "LeftUpperArm", children = { { name = "LeftLowerArm", children = { { name = "LeftHand", children = {} } } } } },
						{ name = "RightUpperArm", children = { { name = "RightLowerArm", children = { { name = "RightHand", children = {} } } } } },
					},
				},
				{ name = "LeftUpperLeg", children = { { name = "LeftLowerLeg", children = { { name = "LeftFoot", children = {} } } } } },
				{ name = "RightUpperLeg", children = { { name = "RightLowerLeg", children = { { name = "RightFoot", children = {} } } } } },
			},
		},
	},
}

local function sin2p(u: number, phaseDeg: number?): number
	return math.sin(2 * math.pi * u + math.rad(phaseDeg or 0))
end

local function cos2p(u: number, phaseDeg: number?): number
	return math.cos(2 * math.pi * u + math.rad(phaseDeg or 0))
end

-- Quintic C2-continuous bell curve for loop touches
local function pulse(u: number, u0: number, um: number, u1: number): number
	if u <= u0 or u >= u1 then
		return 0
	end
	local s = if u <= um then (u - u0) / (um - u0) else (u1 - u) / (u1 - um)
	return s * s * s * (s * (s * 6 - 15) + 10)
end

-- Septic C3-continuous bell curve (zero 1st, 2nd, and 3rd derivative at endpoints and peak) for ultra-smooth cut motion
local function pulseQ(u: number, u0: number, um: number, u1: number): number
	if u <= u0 or u >= u1 then
		return 0
	end
	local s = if u <= um then (u - u0) / (um - u0) else (u1 - u) / (u1 - um)
	local s2 = s * s
	local s4 = s2 * s2
	return s4 * (35 - 84 * s + 70 * s2 - 20 * s2 * s)
end

local function runDribblePose(u: number): PoseMap
	local uLoop = if u >= 1 then 0 else u
	local touchL = pulse(uLoop, 0.05, 0.1875, 0.33)
	local touchR = pulse(uLoop, 0.55, 0.6875, 0.83)

	local pelY = -0.055 + 0.038 * cos2p(2 * uLoop, -35) - 0.075 * (touchL + touchR)
	local pelX = -0.018 * sin2p(uLoop, 0)
	local pelZ = -0.06 - 0.26 * (touchL + touchR)

	local pelPitch = -11.5 + 3.5 * (touchL + touchR)
	local pelYaw = -11.0 * cos2p(uLoop, 0)
	local pelRoll = 2.2 * sin2p(uLoop, 0)

	local chestPitch = -13.0 - 4.5 * (touchL + touchR)
	local chestYaw = 14.0 * cos2p(uLoop, 0)
	local chestRoll = -1.8 * sin2p(uLoop, 0)

	local headPitch = 20.5 + 3.5 * (touchL + touchR)
	local headYaw = -3.0 * cos2p(uLoop, 0)
	local headRoll = -0.4 * sin2p(uLoop, 0)

	local lArmPitch = -48 * cos2p(uLoop, -10) + 12 * touchR
	local rArmPitch = 48 * cos2p(uLoop, -10) + 12 * touchL
	local lElbow = 72 + 16 * sin2p(uLoop, 10)
	local rElbow = 72 - 16 * sin2p(uLoop, 10)

	local lHipPitch = 46 * cos2p(uLoop, -22) + 26 * touchL
	local lHipYaw = -3.5 * cos2p(uLoop, 0) - 4.0 * touchL
	local lHipRoll = -2.0 - 2.0 * touchL
	local lKneePitch = -18 - 48 * (0.5 - 0.5 * cos2p(uLoop, -65)) + 22 * touchL
	local lFootPitch = 12 * cos2p(uLoop, 15) - 26 * touchL
	local lFootYaw = -6.0 * touchL

	local uR = (uLoop + 0.5) % 1
	local rHipPitch = 46 * cos2p(uR, -22) + 26 * touchR
	local rHipYaw = 3.5 * cos2p(uR, 0) + 4.0 * touchR
	local rHipRoll = 2.0 + 2.0 * touchR
	local rKneePitch = -18 - 48 * (0.5 - 0.5 * cos2p(uR, -65)) + 22 * touchR
	local rFootPitch = 12 * cos2p(uR, 15) - 26 * touchR
	local rFootYaw = 6.0 * touchR

	return {
		LowerTorso = { p = Vector3.new(pelX, pelY, pelZ), r = Vector3.new(pelPitch, pelYaw, pelRoll) },
		UpperTorso = { r = Vector3.new(chestPitch, chestYaw, chestRoll) },
		Head = { r = Vector3.new(headPitch, headYaw, headRoll) },
		LeftUpperArm = { r = Vector3.new(lArmPitch, 7.5 * cos2p(uLoop, 0), -14.0) },
		LeftLowerArm = { r = Vector3.new(lElbow, 0, 0) },
		LeftHand = { r = Vector3.new(-5 * cos2p(uLoop, 0), 0, -6) },
		RightUpperArm = { r = Vector3.new(rArmPitch, 7.5 * cos2p(uLoop, 0), 14.0) },
		RightLowerArm = { r = Vector3.new(rElbow, 0, 0) },
		RightHand = { r = Vector3.new(5 * cos2p(uLoop, 0), 0, 6) },
		LeftUpperLeg = { r = Vector3.new(lHipPitch, lHipYaw, lHipRoll) },
		LeftLowerLeg = { r = Vector3.new(lKneePitch, 0, 0) },
		LeftFoot = { r = Vector3.new(lFootPitch, lFootYaw, 1.2) },
		RightUpperLeg = { r = Vector3.new(rHipPitch, rHipYaw, rHipRoll) },
		RightLowerLeg = { r = Vector3.new(rKneePitch, 0, 0) },
		RightFoot = { r = Vector3.new(rFootPitch, rFootYaw, -1.2) },
	}
end

-- Exact R15 support-leg kinematic vertical drop so the planted foot never floats off the turf during knee bend/abduction
local STAND_LEG_HEIGHT = 1.05 * math.cos(math.rad(6)) + 1.05 * math.cos(math.rad(-14))
local function groundedPelvisY(supHipPitchDeg: number, supKneePitchDeg: number, supHipRollDeg: number, extraDrop: number): number
	local hp = math.rad(supHipPitchDeg)
	local kp = math.rad(supKneePitchDeg)
	local hr = math.rad(supHipRollDeg)
	local curH = (1.05 * math.cos(hp) + 1.05 * math.cos(hp + kp)) * math.cos(hr)
	local drop = math.max(0, STAND_LEG_HEIGHT - curH)
	return -(0.055 + drop * 1.15 + extraDrop)
end

local function gGroundPose(pose: PoseMap): PoseMap
	local function transform(sample: JointSample): CFrame
		return CFrame.new(sample.p or Vector3.zero)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(sample.r.X), math.rad(sample.r.Y), math.rad(sample.r.Z))
	end
	local torso = CFrame.new(0, 4.183 - 1.44150245, 0) * transform(pose.LowerTorso)
		* CFrame.new(0, 0.437955648, -0.0999825597)
	local bottoms: { number } = {}
	for _, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
		local chain = G_SUPPORT_CHAINS[side]
		local upper = torso * CFrame.new(chain.hip0) * transform(pose[side .. "UpperLeg"]) * CFrame.new(-chain.hip1)
		local lower = upper * CFrame.new(chain.knee0) * transform(pose[side .. "LowerLeg"]) * CFrame.new(-chain.knee1)
		local foot = lower * CFrame.new(chain.ankle0) * transform(pose[side .. "Foot"]) * CFrame.new(-chain.ankle1)
		local halfHeight = math.abs(foot.XVector.Y) * 0.836178064 / 2
			+ math.abs(foot.YVector.Y) * 0.873450398 / 2
			+ math.abs(foot.ZVector.Y) * 1.242453933 / 2
		table.insert(bottoms, foot.Y - halfHeight)
	end
	local delta = bottoms[1] - bottoms[2]
	local supportBottom = 0.5 * (bottoms[1] + bottoms[2] - math.sqrt(delta * delta + 0.01 * 0.01))
	pose.LowerTorso.p = (pose.LowerTorso.p or Vector3.zero) + Vector3.new(0, 0.015 - supportBottom, 0)
	return pose
end

local function gWalkingFeet(pose: PoseMap, phase: number, forward: number, lateral: number): PoseMap
	if forward == 0 and lateral == 0 then
		return pose
	end
	local function transform(sample: JointSample): CFrame
		return CFrame.new(sample.p or Vector3.zero)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(sample.r.X), math.rad(sample.r.Y), math.rad(sample.r.Z))
	end
	local function sample(frame: CFrame): JointSample
		local x, y, z = frame:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
		return { r = Vector3.new(math.deg(x), math.deg(y), math.deg(z)) }
	end
	local function align(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): CFrame
		local axis = from.Unit:Cross(to.Unit)
		local dot = math.clamp(from.Unit:Dot(to.Unit), -1, 1)
		if axis.Magnitude < 1e-6 then
			return if dot >= 0 then CFrame.identity else CFrame.Angles(math.pi, 0, 0)
		end
		return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.acos(dot))
	end
	local torso = CFrame.new(0, 4.183 - 1.44150245, 0) * transform(pose.LowerTorso)
		* CFrame.new(0, 0.437955648, -0.0999825597)
	for index, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
		local chain = G_SUPPORT_CHAINS[side]
		local q = (phase + (index - 1) * 0.5) % 1
		local halfStep = if lateral ~= 0 then 0.35 else 0.55
		local offset: number
		local lift = 0
		-- 60% planted, 40% low swing; the two feet never swing simultaneously.
		if q <= 0.6 then
			offset = halfStep * (1 - 2 * q / 0.6)
		else
			local t = (q - 0.6) / 0.4
			local t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
			local tangent = -2 * halfStep * 0.4 / 0.6
			offset = -(2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * halfStep
				+ (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * tangent
				+ (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * halfStep
				+ (t3 - t2) * tangent
			lift = 0.18 * math.sin(math.pi * t) ^ 2
		end
		local sign = if side == "Left" then -1 else 1
		local footRotation = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(sign * 5), 0)
		local foot = CFrame.new(sign * 0.78 + lateral * offset, 0.873450398 / 2 + 0.02 + lift, -0.05 - forward * offset)
			* footRotation
		local hip = torso:PointToWorldSpace(chain.hip0)
		local ankle = foot:PointToWorldSpace(chain.ankle1)
		local upperVector, lowerVector = chain.knee0 - chain.hip1, chain.ankle0 - chain.knee1
		local upperLength, lowerLength = upperVector.Magnitude, lowerVector.Magnitude
		local reach = ankle - hip
		local distance = math.clamp(reach.Magnitude, math.abs(upperLength - lowerLength) + 0.001, upperLength + lowerLength - 0.001)
		local direction = reach.Unit
		local pole = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local bend = (pole - direction * pole:Dot(direction)).Unit
		local along = (upperLength * upperLength + distance * distance - lowerLength * lowerLength) / (2 * distance)
		local knee = hip + direction * along + bend * math.sqrt(math.max(0, upperLength * upperLength - along * along))
		local upper = CFrame.new(hip) * align(upperVector, knee - hip) * CFrame.new(-chain.hip1)
		local lower = CFrame.new(knee) * align(lowerVector, ankle - knee) * CFrame.new(-chain.knee1)
		pose[side .. "UpperLeg"] = sample(CFrame.new(-chain.hip0) * torso:Inverse() * upper * CFrame.new(chain.hip1))
		pose[side .. "LowerLeg"] = sample(CFrame.new(-chain.knee0) * upper:Inverse() * lower * CFrame.new(chain.knee1))
		pose[side .. "Foot"] = sample(CFrame.new(-chain.ankle0) * lower:Inverse() * foot * CFrame.new(chain.ankle1))
	end
	return pose
end

-- Owner-provided 3s walking loop, with source joint rotations/timestamps and level gaze.
-- Root X/Z travel stays with the game controller; baked support height fits the rig.
local function walkDribblePose(u: number): PoseMap
	local frames = WalkDribbleReference.Frames
	local time = math.clamp(u, 0, 1) * 3
	local index = math.clamp(math.floor(time * 30) + 1, 1, #frames - 1)
	while index > 1 and frames[index].time > time do
		index -= 1
	end
	while index < #frames - 1 and frames[index + 1].time < time do
		index += 1
	end
	local first, second = frames[index], frames[index + 1]
	local alpha = math.clamp((time - first.time) / (second.time - first.time), 0, 1)
	local pose: PoseMap = {}
	for joint, name in ipairs(WalkDribbleReference.Parts) do
		local rotation = first.rotations[joint]:Lerp(second.rotations[joint], alpha)
		local x, y, z = rotation:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
		pose[name] = { r = Vector3.new(math.deg(x), math.deg(y), math.deg(z)) }
	end
	pose.LowerTorso.p = Vector3.new(0, first.travel.Y + (second.travel.Y - first.travel.Y) * alpha, 0)
	-- Keep the accepted body lean, but compensate at the neck so the gaze stays level.
	-- Preserve the reference's horizontal look direction and head roll.
	local function rotation(r: Vector3): CFrame
		return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(r.X), math.rad(r.Y), math.rad(r.Z))
	end
	local body = rotation(pose.LowerTorso.r) * rotation(pose.UpperTorso.r)
	local head = body * rotation(pose.Head.r)
	local forward = Vector3.new(head.LookVector.X, 0, head.LookVector.Z)
	if forward.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		local roll = math.atan2(head.RightVector.Y, head.UpVector.Y)
		local level = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, forward.Unit) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll)
		local x, y, z = (body:Inverse() * level):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
		pose.Head.r = Vector3.new(math.deg(x), math.deg(y), math.deg(z))
	end
	return gGroundPose(pose)
end

-- Goal-facing duel stance: a wider, crouched base with bent arms and low lateral steps.
-- Sinusoidal weight transfer and knee flexion keep velocity continuous at loop seams.
local function gModeGroundStepPose(u: number, forward: number, lateral: number): PoseMap
	local phase = if u >= 1 then 0 else u
	local stride = sin2p(phase, 0)
	local cycle = cos2p(phase, 0)
	local liftL = 0.5 - 0.5 * cycle
	local liftR = 0.5 + 0.5 * cycle
	local moving = math.max(math.abs(forward), math.abs(lateral))
	local side = math.abs(lateral)
	local sway = (0.008 + 0.035 * moving + 0.025 * side) * stride
	local sideRoll = lateral * 6.5 * stride
	local hipSwing = 16 * forward * stride + 6 * side * cycle
	local shuffle = 5 * side
	local hipL = 22 + hipSwing
	local hipR = 22 - hipSwing
	local kneeL = -44 - 12 * moving * liftL
	local kneeR = -44 - 12 * moving * liftR
	local rollL = -9 + sideRoll
	local rollR = 9 + sideRoll
	-- Smooth maximum follows the longer support leg without a hard support switch.
	local supportYLeft = groundedPelvisY(hipL - 7, kneeL, rollL, 0)
	local supportYRight = groundedPelvisY(hipR - 7, kneeR, rollR, 0)
	local heightDelta = supportYLeft - supportYRight
	local pelvisY = 0.5 * (supportYLeft + supportYRight + math.sqrt(heightDelta * heightDelta + 0.015 * 0.015))

	local pose = gGroundPose({
		LowerTorso = {
			p = Vector3.new(sway, pelvisY, -0.035),
			r = Vector3.new(-7, -1.5 * moving * stride, -1.5 * moving * stride),
		},
		UpperTorso = { r = Vector3.new(-9, 3 * moving * stride, 1.5 * moving * stride) },
		Head = { r = Vector3.new(16, -1.5 * moving * stride, 0) },
		LeftUpperArm = { r = Vector3.new(14 - 10 * moving * stride, -7, -30 - 3 * moving * cycle) },
		LeftLowerArm = { r = Vector3.new(58 + 5 * moving * stride, -5, -3) },
		LeftHand = { r = Vector3.new(-5, 0, -7) },
		RightUpperArm = { r = Vector3.new(14 + 10 * moving * stride, 7, 30 + 3 * moving * cycle) },
		RightLowerArm = { r = Vector3.new(58 - 5 * moving * stride, 5, 3) },
		RightHand = { r = Vector3.new(-5, 0, 7) },
		LeftUpperLeg = { r = Vector3.new(hipL, -shuffle, rollL) },
		LeftLowerLeg = { r = Vector3.new(kneeL, 0, 0) },
		LeftFoot = { r = Vector3.new(29 - 6 * moving * liftL, -2 * side, 4 - sideRoll * 0.5) },
		RightUpperLeg = { r = Vector3.new(hipR, shuffle, rollR) },
		RightLowerLeg = { r = Vector3.new(kneeR, 0, 0) },
		RightFoot = { r = Vector3.new(29 - 6 * moving * liftR, 2 * side, -4 - sideRoll * 0.5) },
	})
	return gWalkingFeet(pose, phase, forward, lateral)
end

local function mirrorCutPose(pose: PoseMap): PoseMap
	local mirrored: PoseMap = {}
	for name, joint in pairs(pose) do
		local other = if name:sub(1, 4) == "Left" then "Right" .. name:sub(5)
			elseif name:sub(1, 5) == "Right" then "Left" .. name:sub(6) else name
		local p = joint.p
		mirrored[other] = {
			p = if p then Vector3.new(-p.X, p.Y, p.Z) else nil,
			r = Vector3.new(joint.r.X, -joint.r.Y, -joint.r.Z),
		}
	end
	return mirrored
end

local function makeReferenceCutPose(dirSign: number, turnDegrees: number)
	return function(u: number): PoseMap
		local time = math.clamp(u, 0, 1) * CutTimeline.Duration
		local frames = SprintCutReference.Frames
		local index = math.clamp(math.floor(time * 30) + 1, 1, #frames - 1)
		while index > 1 and frames[index].time > time do index -= 1 end
		while index < #frames - 1 and frames[index + 1].time < time do index += 1 end
		local first, second = frames[index], frames[index + 1]
		local alpha = math.clamp((time - first.time) / (second.time - first.time), 0, 1)
		local pose: PoseMap = {}
		local turnGain = (turnDegrees - 45) / 135
		local plant = math.sin(math.pi * u) ^ 2
		for joint, name in ipairs(SprintCutReference.Parts) do
			local rotation = first.rotations[joint]:Lerp(second.rotations[joint], alpha)
			if name == "LowerTorso" then
				local look = rotation.LookVector
				rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, -math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), 0) * rotation
				rotation *= CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-8 * turnGain * plant), 0)
			end
			local x, y, z = rotation:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
			pose[name] = { r = Vector3.new(math.deg(x), math.deg(y), math.deg(z)) }
		end
		pose.LowerTorso.p = Vector3.new(-0.06 * plant, first.travel.Y + (second.travel.Y - first.travel.Y) * alpha, 0)
		if dirSign < 0 then pose = mirrorCutPose(pose) end
		return gGroundPose(pose)
	end
end

		poseAt = gModeRightStepPose,
	},
}

local DribbleClipData = {
	Definitions = Definitions,
}

function DribbleClipData.BuildKeyframeSequence(clipName: string): KeyframeSequence?
	local def = Definitions[clipName]
	if not def then
		return nil
	end

	local sequence = Instance.new("KeyframeSequence")
	sequence.Name = def.name
	sequence.Loop = def.loop
	sequence.Priority = def.priority

	local function buildPose(node: any, poseMap: PoseMap): Pose
		local pose = Instance.new("Pose")
		pose.Name = node.name
		local sample = poseMap[node.name]
		pose.Weight = if sample then 1 else 0
		pose.EasingStyle = Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Cubic
		pose.EasingDirection = Enum.PoseEasingDirection.InOut
		if sample then
			local baseCf = if sample.p then CFrame.new(sample.p) else CFrame.identity
			pose.CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(sample.r.X), math.rad(sample.r.Y), math.rad(sample.r.Z))
		else
			pose.CFrame = CFrame.identity
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(node.children) do
			pose:AddSubPose(buildPose(child, poseMap))
		end
		return pose
	end

	local frames: { Keyframe } = {}
	for i = 0, def.keyCount - 1 do
		local u = i / (def.keyCount - 1)
		local timeSec = if def.frameTimes then def.frameTimes[i + 1] else math.round(u * def.duration * 1000) / 1000
		local poseMap = def.poseAt(if def.frameTimes then timeSec / def.duration else u)
		local frame = Instance.new("Keyframe")
		frame.Time = timeSec
		frame:AddPose(buildPose(R15_TREE, poseMap))
		table.insert(frames, frame)
	end

	for _, m in ipairs(def.markers) do
		local bestFrame: Keyframe = frames[1]
		local bestDist = math.huge
		for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
			local dist = math.abs(frame.Time - m.t)
			if dist < bestDist then
				bestDist = dist
				bestFrame = frame
			end
		end
		local marker = Instance.new("KeyframeMarker")
		marker.Name = m.name
		marker.Value = m.value
		bestFrame:AddMarker(marker)
	end

	for _, frame in ipairs(frames) do
		sequence:AddKeyframe(frame)
	end

	return sequence
end

return table.freeze(DribbleClipData)

--!strict
-- src/client/character/DribbleAnimationHelper.luau
-- KeyframeSequence validator, Studio fallback registrar, and marker intent helper for R15 Dribble/Cut/G clips.
-- Governed by RF02-DRIBBLE-ANIMATION-INTEGRATION Contract (2026-10-27).

local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 10) :: Folder?
assert(Shared ~= nil, "[DribbleAnimationHelper] Shared folder missing in ReplicatedStorage")
local configs = Shared:WaitForChild("configs", 10) :: Folder?
assert(configs ~= nil, "[DribbleAnimationHelper] configs folder missing in Shared")
local DribbleActionConfigs = require(configs:WaitForChild("DribbleActionConfigs"))
local DribbleClipData = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DribbleClipData"))

export type DribbleLoopKey =
	| "WalkDribble"
	| "RunDribble"
	| "GModeLoop"
	| "GoalForward"
	| "GoalBackward"
	| "GoalLeft"
	| "GoalRight"
export type DribbleCutKey = "FrontLeft" | "FrontRight" | "BackLeft" | "BackRight" | "ReverseLeft" | "ReverseRight" | "GoalReverse"
export type DribbleClipKey = DribbleLoopKey | DribbleCutKey

export type LoopTrackCache = {
	WalkDribble: AnimationTrack?,
	RunDribble: AnimationTrack?,
	GModeLoop: AnimationTrack?,
	GoalForward: AnimationTrack?,
	GoalBackward: AnimationTrack?,
	GoalLeft: AnimationTrack?,
	GoalRight: AnimationTrack?,
}

export type LoopRegistrationSources = {
	WalkDribble: string,
	RunDribble: string,
	GModeLoop: string,
	GoalForward: string,
	GoalBackward: string,
	GoalLeft: string,
	GoalRight: string,
}

local cachedStudioTempIds: { [string]: string } = {}
local warnedProductionMissing: { [string]: boolean } = {}
local lastTouchSentTime: number = 0
local nextCutId = 0
local ballActionRemoteRef: RemoteEvent? = nil

local DribbleAnimationHelper = {}

local function getBallActionRemote(): RemoteEvent?
	if ballActionRemoteRef and ballActionRemoteRef.Parent then
		return ballActionRemoteRef
	end
	local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CageZeroRemotes")
	if remotesFolder then
		local r = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("BallActionRequest")
		if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			ballActionRemoteRef = r
		end
	end
	return ballActionRemoteRef
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.ValidateClip(clip: Instance, spec: DribbleActionConfigs.DribbleClipSpec): (boolean, string?)
	if not clip:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
		return false, "Clip is not a KeyframeSequence"
	end
	if clip.Name ~= spec.ClipName then
		return false, "Clip name mismatch: expected " .. spec.ClipName .. ", got " .. clip.Name
	end
	if clip.Loop ~= spec.ExpectedLoop then
		return false, "Clip Loop mismatch: expected " .. tostring(spec.ExpectedLoop) .. ", got " .. tostring(clip.Loop)
	end
	if clip.Priority ~= spec.ExpectedPriority then
		return false, "Clip Priority mismatch: expected " .. spec.ExpectedPriority.Name .. ", got " .. clip.Priority.Name
	end

	local keyframes = clip:GetKeyframes()
	if #keyframes ~= spec.ExpectedKeyframeCount then
		return false, string.format("Keyframe count mismatch: expected %d, got %d", spec.ExpectedKeyframeCount, #keyframes)
	end

	local minTime = math.huge
	local maxTime = -math.huge
	local markerCount = 0
	local hasTouchMarker = false
	for _, kf in ipairs(keyframes) do
		if kf.Time < minTime then
			minTime = kf.Time
		end
		if kf.Time > maxTime then
			maxTime = kf.Time
		end
		if kf:IsA("Keyframe") then
			local markers = kf:GetMarkers()
			markerCount += #markers
			for _, m in ipairs(markers) do
				if m.Name == "TouchL" or m.Name == "TouchR" then
					hasTouchMarker = true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local duration = maxTime - minTime
	if math.abs(duration - spec.ExpectedDuration) > spec.DurationTolerance then
		return false, string.format("Duration mismatch: expected %.2f, got %.2f", spec.ExpectedDuration, duration)
	end

	local firstKf = keyframes[1]
	local drivenJoints = 0
	for _, desc in ipairs(firstKf:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Pose") and desc.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			drivenJoints += 1
		end
	end
	if drivenJoints ~= spec.ExpectedDrivenJoints then
		return false, string.format("Driven joints mismatch: expected %d, got %d", spec.ExpectedDrivenJoints, drivenJoints)
	end

	if markerCount < 1 or not hasTouchMarker then
		return false, "Missing required TouchL/TouchR KeyframeMarkers"
	end

	return true, nil
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.ResolveAnimation(key: string): (Animation?, string)
	local specs = DribbleActionConfigs.Clips :: { [string]: DribbleActionConfigs.DribbleClipSpec }
	local spec = specs[key]
	if not spec then
		return nil, "UNKNOWN_KEY"
	end

	local publishedMap = DribbleActionConfigs.PublishedIds :: { [string]: string? }
	local approvedCutMap = DribbleActionConfigs.ApprovedCutAnimations :: { [string]: string? }
	local publishedId = publishedMap[key]
	local cutBinding = approvedCutMap[key]
	if not publishedId and cutBinding and string.match(cutBinding, "^rbxassetid://%d+$") then
		publishedId = cutBinding
	end

	if publishedId and string.match(publishedId, "^rbxassetid://%d+$") then
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.Name = "R15_Dribble_" .. key .. "_Published"
		anim.AnimationId = publishedId
		return anim, "PUBLISHED"
	end

	if not DribbleActionConfigs.IsStudioFallbackAllowed() then
		if not warnedProductionMissing[key] then
			warn("[DribbleAnimationHelper] Published AnimationId for " .. key .. " is missing in production.")
			warnedProductionMissing[key] = true
		end
		return nil, "PRODUCTION_MISSING"
	end

	local clipName = spec.ClipName
	if cachedStudioTempIds[clipName] then
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.Name = "R15_Dribble_" .. key .. "_StudioFallback"
		anim.AnimationId = cachedStudioTempIds[clipName]
		return anim, "STUDIO_FALLBACK"
	end

	local previewRigs = workspace:FindFirstChild("PreviewRigs")
	local previewRig = previewRigs and previewRigs:FindFirstChild("PreviewRig_R15_Boy_Height30")
	local animSaves = previewRig and previewRig:FindFirstChild("AnimSaves")
	local clip: Instance? = animSaves and animSaves:FindFirstChild(clipName)
	local sourceTag = "STUDIO_FALLBACK"
	local builtTemporary = false

	if not clip then
		clip = DribbleClipData.BuildKeyframeSequence(clipName)
		sourceTag = "STUDIO_IMMUTABLE_DATA"
		builtTemporary = true
	end

	if not clip then
		warn("[DribbleAnimationHelper] Clip not found for " .. key .. " (" .. clipName .. ")")
		return nil, "CLIP_NOT_FOUND"
	end

	local isValid, err = DribbleAnimationHelper.ValidateClip(clip, spec)
	if not isValid then
		if builtTemporary then
			clip:Destroy()
		end
		warn("[DribbleAnimationHelper] Clip validation failed for " .. key .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		return nil, "CLIP_VALIDATION_FAILED"
	end

	local ok, tempId = pcall(function()
		return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(clip :: KeyframeSequence)
	end)
	if builtTemporary then
		clip:Destroy()
	end

	if not ok or not tempId or typeof(tempId) ~= "string" or #tempId == 0 then
		warn("[DribbleAnimationHelper] Failed to register KeyframeSequence for " .. key)
		return nil, "REGISTRATION_FAILED"
	end

	cachedStudioTempIds[clipName] = tempId
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.Name = "R15_Dribble_" .. key .. "_" .. sourceTag
	anim.AnimationId = tempId
	return anim, sourceTag
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.WarmupCutTracks(animator: Animator)
	local cutKeys: { DribbleCutKey } = {
		"FrontLeft",
		"FrontRight",
		"BackLeft",
		"BackRight",
		"ReverseLeft",
		"ReverseRight",
		"GoalReverse",
	}
	local warmupTracks: { AnimationTrack } = {}
	local warmupAnims: { Animation } = {}

	for _, key in ipairs(cutKeys) do
		local binding = (DribbleActionConfigs.ApprovedCutAnimations :: { [string]: string? })[key]
		if binding and #binding > 0 then
			local anim = DribbleAnimationHelper.ResolveAnimation(key)
			if anim then
				table.insert(warmupAnims, anim)
				local ok, tr = pcall(function()
					return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
				end)
				if ok and tr then
					table.insert(warmupTracks, tr)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local deadline = os.clock() + 0.25
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		local allReady = true
		for _, tr in ipairs(warmupTracks) do
			if tr.Length <= 0 then
				allReady = false
				break
			end
		end
		if allReady then
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.02)
	end

	for _, tr in ipairs(warmupTracks) do
		pcall(function()
			tr:Stop(0)
			tr:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	for _, anim in ipairs(warmupAnims) do
		pcall(function()
			anim:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.LoadLoopTracks(animator: Animator): (LoopTrackCache, LoopRegistrationSources, { Animation })
	local tracks: LoopTrackCache = {
		WalkDribble = nil,
		RunDribble = nil,
		GModeLoop = nil,
		GoalForward = nil,
		GoalBackward = nil,
		GoalLeft = nil,
		GoalRight = nil,
	}
	local sources: LoopRegistrationSources = {
		WalkDribble = "NONE",
		RunDribble = "NONE",
		GModeLoop = "NONE",
		GoalForward = "NONE",
		GoalBackward = "NONE",
		GoalLeft = "NONE",
		GoalRight = "NONE",
	}
	local animInstances: { Animation } = {}

	local keys: { DribbleLoopKey } = {
		"WalkDribble",
		"RunDribble",
		"GModeLoop",
		"GoalForward",
		"GoalBackward",
		"GoalLeft",
		"GoalRight",
	}
	for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
		local anim, src = DribbleAnimationHelper.ResolveAnimation(key)
		sources[key] = src
		if anim then
			table.insert(animInstances, anim)
			local spec = (DribbleActionConfigs.Clips :: { [string]: DribbleActionConfigs.DribbleClipSpec })[key]
			local ok, track = pcall(function()
				return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
			end)
			if ok and track then
				track.Priority = spec.ExpectedPriority
				track.Looped = spec.ExpectedLoop
				tracks[key] = track
			else
				sources[key] = "LOAD_FAILED"
			end
		end
	end

	return tracks, sources, animInstances
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.LoadCutTrack(animator: Animator, name: string): (AnimationTrack?, string?)
	local approved = (DribbleActionConfigs.ApprovedCutAnimations :: { [string]: string? })[name]
	if not approved or #approved == 0 then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local spec = (DribbleActionConfigs.Clips :: { [string]: DribbleActionConfigs.DribbleClipSpec })[name]
	if not spec then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local anim: Animation? = nil
	if string.match(approved, "^rbxassetid://%d+$") then
		anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.Name = "R15_Cut_" .. name
		anim.AnimationId = approved
	elseif approved == spec.ClipName then
		anim = DribbleAnimationHelper.ResolveAnimation(name)
	else
		return nil, nil
	end

	if not anim then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local ok, loaded = pcall(function()
		return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	end)
	anim:Destroy()
	if not ok or not loaded then
		return nil, nil
	end

	return loaded :: AnimationTrack, spec.ClipName
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.CleanupLoopTracks(tracks: LoopTrackCache, animInstances: { Animation })
	for _, track in pairs(tracks) do
		if track then
			pcall(function()
				track:Stop(0)
				track:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	for _, anim in ipairs(animInstances) do
		pcall(function()
			anim:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(animInstances)
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyTouchMarker(character: Model, foot: string, clipName: string, isCut: boolean, cutId: number?, phase: string?)
	if not character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") ~= true then
		return
	end
	if not isCut and character:GetAttribute("DribbleCutActive") == true
		and (character:GetAttribute("DribbleCutControlReleaseReached") ~= true
			or character:GetAttribute("DribbleCutVisualOwner") == true) then
		return
	end
	if foot ~= "L" and foot ~= "R" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if phase ~= "Release" then
		local prevCount = character:GetAttribute("DribbleTouchCount")
		local nextCount = (if typeof(prevCount) == "number" then prevCount else 0) + 1
		character:SetAttribute("LastDribbleTouchFoot", foot)
		character:SetAttribute("LastDribbleTouchTime", now)
		character:SetAttribute("LastDribbleTouchClip", clipName)
		character:SetAttribute("DribbleTouchCount", nextCount)
	end

	if phase == nil and now - lastTouchSentTime < DribbleActionConfigs.TOUCH_INTENT_COOLDOWN_SEC then
		return
	end
	if phase == nil then lastTouchSentTime = now end

	local remote = getBallActionRemote()
	if remote then
		pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer({
				action = "DribbleTouch",
				foot = foot,
				clip = clipName,
				isCut = isCut,
				cutId = cutId,
				phase = phase,
				character = character,
			})
		end)
	end
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyCutIntent(character: Model, cutKey: string, exitDirection: Vector3): number?
	if not character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") ~= true then
		return nil
	end
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(exitDirection.X, 0, exitDirection.Z)
	if horizontal.Magnitude < 0.5 or horizontal.Magnitude ~= horizontal.Magnitude then
		return nil
	end
	local remote = getBallActionRemote()
	if remote then
		nextCutId += 1
		local id = nextCutId
		local ok = pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer({
				action = "DribbleCut",
				cut = cutKey,
				direction = horizontal.Unit,
				character = character,
				cutId = id,
			})
		end)
		if ok then return id end
	end
	return nil
end

function DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyCutCancel(character: Model, cutId: number)
	local remote = getBallActionRemote()
	if remote then
		remote:FireServer({ action = "DribbleCut", cancel = true, cutId = cutId, character = character })
	end
end

return table.freeze(DribbleAnimationHelper)

sources.source:
--!strict
-- Only an Owner-approved, successfully loaded one-shot clip can lock movement.
-- Governed by RF02-DRIBBLE-ANIMATION-INTEGRATION Contract (2026-10-27).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("configs"):WaitForChild("DribbleActionConfigs"))
local CutTimeline = require(Shared:WaitForChild("DribbleCutTimeline"))
local CharacterFolder = script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("character")
local DribbleAnimationHelper = require(CharacterFolder:WaitForChild("DribbleAnimationHelper"))

local Controller = {}
local track: AnimationTrack? = nil
local activeConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local lockedCharacter: Model? = nil
local activeCutName: string? = nil
local activeClipName: string? = nil
local activeCutDirection: Vector3? = nil
local activeEntryDirection: Vector3? = nil
local cutTouchReached: boolean = false
local deadline = 0.0
local activeCutId: number? = nil

local function disconnectAll()
	for _, conn in ipairs(activeConnections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(activeConnections)
end

function Controller.Cancel()
	disconnectAll()
	if lockedCharacter and activeCutId then
		DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyCutCancel(lockedCharacter, activeCutId)
	end
	activeCutId = nil
	local old = track
	track = nil
	activeCutName = nil
	activeClipName = nil
	activeCutDirection = nil
	activeEntryDirection = nil
	cutTouchReached = false
	if lockedCharacter then
		lockedCharacter:SetAttribute("DribbleCutActive", false)
		lockedCharacter:SetAttribute("DribbleCutName", "")
		lockedCharacter:SetAttribute("DribbleCutClipName", "")
		lockedCharacter:SetAttribute("DribbleCutControlReleaseReached", false)
		lockedCharacter:SetAttribute("DribbleCutBallPhase", "")
		lockedCharacter:SetAttribute("DribbleCutVisualOwner", false)
	end
	lockedCharacter = nil
	deadline = 0
	if old then
		pcall(function()
			local fade = Config.CUT_FADE_SEC or 0.15
			old:Stop(fade)
			task.delay(fade + 0.05, function()
				pcall(function()
					old:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end
end

function Controller.TryStart(character: Model, name: string, exitDirection: Vector3?, entryDirection: Vector3?): boolean
	if track then
		return false
	end
	if not character or character:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") ~= true then
		return false
	end

	local approved = (Config.ApprovedCutAnimations :: { [string]: string })[name]
	if not approved or #approved == 0 then
		return false
	end

	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not animator or hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end

	local newTrack, resolvedClipName = DribbleAnimationHelper.LoadCutTrack(animator, name)
	if not newTrack or not resolvedClipName then
		warn("[DribbleCut] Approved clip failed to load: " .. name)
		return false
	end

	if newTrack.Length <= 0 or newTrack.Length > Config.CUT_MAX_DURATION then
		newTrack:Destroy()
		warn("[DribbleCut] Clip is not ready or exceeds bounded lock duration: " .. name)
		return false
	end

	track = newTrack
	lockedCharacter = character
	activeCutName = name
	activeClipName = resolvedClipName
	cutTouchReached = false
	local profile = CutTimeline.Get(name)
	if exitDirection and exitDirection.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		activeCutDirection = exitDirection.Unit
	else
		activeCutDirection = nil
	end
	if entryDirection and entryDirection.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		activeEntryDirection = entryDirection.Unit
	else
		activeEntryDirection = activeCutDirection
	end
	deadline = os.clock() + math.min(Config.CUT_MAX_DURATION, newTrack.Length + 0.15)
	newTrack.Looped = false
	newTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

	character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutActive", true)
	character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutName", name)
	character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutClipName", resolvedClipName)
	character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutControlReleaseReached", false)
	character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutBallPhase", "Approach")
	character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutVisualOwner", profile ~= nil)

	if profile then
		table.insert(activeConnections, newTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("BallTrap"):Connect(function(foot: string)
			if track == newTrack and lockedCharacter == character then
				character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutBallPhase", "Trapped")
				DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyTouchMarker(character, foot, resolvedClipName, true, activeCutId, "Trap")
			end
		end))
	end

	table.insert(
		activeConnections,
		newTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("TouchL"):Connect(function()
			if track == newTrack and lockedCharacter == character then
				cutTouchReached = true
				character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutBallPhase", "Struck")
				DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyTouchMarker(character, "L", resolvedClipName, true, activeCutId, if profile then "Strike" else nil)
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		activeConnections,
		newTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("TouchR"):Connect(function()
			if track == newTrack and lockedCharacter == character then
				cutTouchReached = true
				character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutBallPhase", "Struck")
				DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyTouchMarker(character, "R", resolvedClipName, true, activeCutId, if profile then "Strike" else nil)
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		activeConnections,
		newTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("ControlRelease"):Connect(function()
			if track == newTrack and lockedCharacter == character then
				character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutControlReleaseReached", true)
				character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutBallPhase", "Released")
				if profile then
					DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyTouchMarker(character, profile.StrikeFoot, resolvedClipName, true, activeCutId, "Release")
					return
				end
				local fadeOut = Config.CUT_FADE_OUT_SEC or 0.18
				pcall(function()
					newTrack:AdjustWeight(0.001, fadeOut)
				end)
			end
		end)
	)
	if profile then
		table.insert(activeConnections, newTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("BlendOut"):Connect(function()
			if track == newTrack then
				character:SetAttribute("DribbleCutVisualOwner", false)
				newTrack:AdjustWeight(0.001, Config.CUT_FADE_OUT_SEC)
			end
		end))
	end

	table.insert(
		activeConnections,
		newTrack.Ended:Connect(function()
			if track == newTrack then
				Controller.Cancel()
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		activeConnections,
		newTrack.Stopped:Connect(function()
			if track == newTrack then
				Controller.Cancel()
			end
		end)
	)

	if exitDirection then
		activeCutId = DribbleAnimationHelper.NotifyCutIntent(character, name, exitDirection)
		if not activeCutId then Controller.Cancel() return false end
	end
	newTrack:Play(Config.CUT_FADE_SEC)
	return true
end

function Controller.IsLocked(character: Model): boolean
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if
		lockedCharacter ~= character
		or not hum
		or hum.Health <= 0
		or hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
		or character:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") ~= true
		or os.clock() >= deadline
		or (track ~= nil and not track.IsPlaying)
	then
		Controller.Cancel()
	end
	return track ~= nil
end

function Controller.IsControlReleased(character: Model?): boolean
	if not track or lockedCharacter ~= character then
		return true
	end
	if character and character:GetAttribute("DribbleCutControlReleaseReached") == true then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Controller.GetActiveTrack(): AnimationTrack?
	return track
end

function Controller.GetActiveCutName(): string?
	return activeCutName
end

function Controller.GetActiveClipName(): string?
	return activeClipName
end

function Controller.GetActiveCutDirection(): Vector3?
	if not track or not activeCutDirection then
		return activeCutDirection
	end
	if activeCutName and CutTimeline.Get(activeCutName) then
		local entry = activeEntryDirection or activeCutDirection
		if not cutTouchReached then return entry end
		local angle = math.atan2(entry:Cross(activeCutDirection).Y, math.clamp(entry:Dot(activeCutDirection), -1, 1))
		return CFrame.Angles(0, angle * CutTimeline.DirectionAlpha(track.TimePosition), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(entry).Unit
	end
	if cutTouchReached then
		return activeCutDirection
	end
	local entry = activeEntryDirection or activeCutDirection
	-- For 180-degree reverse cuts (W->S), keep moving/facing along entry until the foot traps the ball (TouchR),
	-- then flip cleanly to the opposite direction so the body doesn't swing sideways right!
	if activeCutName == "ReverseLeft" or activeCutName == "ReverseRight" or activeCutName == "GoalReverse" then
		return entry
	end
	local strikePhase = Config.CUT_BALL_STRIKE_PHASE or 0.36
	local u = if track.Length > 0.01 then math.clamp(track.TimePosition / track.Length, 0, 1) else 1.0
	local alpha = math.clamp(u / math.max(0.05, strikePhase), 0, 1)
	local s = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
	local blended = entry * (1 - s) + activeCutDirection * s
	if blended.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		return blended.Unit
	end
	return activeCutDirection
end

function Controller.GetMovementSpeedFactor(): number
	if track and activeCutName and CutTimeline.Get(activeCutName) then
		return CutTimeline.SpeedFactor(track.TimePosition)
	end
	return 1
end

return Controller

--!strict
-- src/client/controllers/MovementHeadingPreviewController.luau
-- Camera-Relative Movement Adapter: Grounded Reticle Facing (ShiftLock style) + Continuous Camera-Relative WASD
-- Governed by RF02-CAMERA-RELATIVE Hand-Off Contract (2026-10-27)

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local ConfigsFolder = Shared:WaitForChild("configs")
local CameraPreviewConfigs = require(ConfigsFolder:WaitForChild("CameraPreviewConfigs"))
local JumpConfigs = require(ConfigsFolder:WaitForChild("JumpConfigs"))
local DribbleConfigs = require(ConfigsFolder:WaitForChild("DribbleConfigs"))
local DribbleGeometryHelper = require(Shared:WaitForChild("DribbleGeometryHelper"))
local DribbleActionConfigs = require(ConfigsFolder:WaitForChild("DribbleActionConfigs"))
local DribbleControlRules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("DribbleControlRules"))
local DribbleCutController = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DribbleCutController"))
local MOVEMENT_STEP_NAME = "CageZeroMovementHeadingStep"

local MovementHeadingPreviewController = {}

local isInitialized = false
local isActive = false

-- Native PlayerModule controls handle
local nativeControls: any = nil

-- Key state tracking
local isWDown = false
local isSDown = false
local isADown = false
local isDDown = false
local isSpaceDown = false
local isGHeld = false
local goalDirection: Vector3? = nil
local lastGoalIntent = false
local lastGoalSentTime = 0.0
local lastCutChord = "NONE"
local lastCutInput = Vector3.zero
local lastCutWorldDir = Vector3.zero
local lastCutInputTime = 0.0
local lastCutEndTime = 0.0

-- Bounded jump input buffer (os.clock deadline); cleared once Humanoid enters Jumping
local jumpBufferUntil: number = 0

-- Movement State
local currentChord: string = "NONE"
local currentWorldDirection: Vector3 = Vector3.zero

-- Phase-Aware Dribble Turn Gate State (RF02-DRIBBLE-RECEIVE 2026-10-27)
local rawWorldDirection: Vector3 = Vector3.zero
local dribbleTurnFactor: number = 1.0

-- Cut speed scale: drops to the cut factor when a cut starts, recovers smoothly afterwards (movement never freezes)
local cutSpeedScale: number = 1.0
local CUT_REVERSE_NAMES = { ReverseLeft = true, ReverseRight = true, GoalReverse = true }

-- Character tracking
local currentCharacter: Model? = nil
local currentHumanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local currentHrp: BasePart? = nil

-- Remote handle for carrier camera intent reporting
local ballActionRemoteRef: any = nil
local lastSentCameraIntent: number = 0

local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

-- References (lazy required to avoid circular dependencies)
local cameraControllerRef: any = nil
local airMovementControllerRef: any = nil
local sprintControllerRef: any = nil

local function getCameraController(): any
	if cameraControllerRef ~= nil then
		return cameraControllerRef
	end
	local controllers = script.Parent
	if controllers then
		local mod = controllers:FindFirstChild("CameraPreviewController")
		if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			cameraControllerRef = require(mod)
		end
	end
	return cameraControllerRef
end

local function getAirMovementController(): any
	if airMovementControllerRef ~= nil then
		return airMovementControllerRef
	end
	local controllers = script.Parent
	local mod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("AirMovementController")
	if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		airMovementControllerRef = require(mod)
	end
	return airMovementControllerRef
end

local function getSprintController(): any
	if sprintControllerRef ~= nil then
		return sprintControllerRef
	end
	local controllers = script.Parent
	local mod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("SprintController")
	if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		sprintControllerRef = require(mod)
	end
	return sprintControllerRef
end

local function getBallActionRemote(): RemoteEvent?
	if ballActionRemoteRef ~= nil then
		return ballActionRemoteRef
	end
	local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CageZeroRemotes")
	if remotesFolder then
		local r = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("BallActionRequest")
		if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			ballActionRemoteRef = r
		end
	end
	return ballActionRemoteRef
end

local function notifyMovementIntent(isMoving: boolean, forward: number)
	local sprintCtrl = getSprintController()
	if sprintCtrl then
		if sprintCtrl.SetMovementIntent then
			sprintCtrl.SetMovementIntent(isMoving)
		elseif sprintCtrl.SetForwardIntent then
			sprintCtrl.SetForwardIntent(forward)
		end
	end
end

local function getCameraYaw(): number
	local camCtrl = getCameraController()
	if camCtrl and camCtrl.GetCameraYaw then
		return camCtrl.GetCameraYaw()
	end
	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then
		local _, y, _ = cam.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		return y
	end
	return 0.0
end

local function publishLeanInput(direction: Vector3)
	local airCtrl = getAirMovementController()
	if airCtrl and airCtrl.SetLeanInputDirection then
		airCtrl.SetLeanInputDirection(direction)
	end
end

local function computeLocalInputVector(): (Vector3, string, number)
	local forward = (isWDown and 1 or 0) - (isSDown and 1 or 0)
	local lateral = (isDDown and 1 or 0) - (isADown and 1 or 0)

	local chord = ""
	if forward > 0 then
		chord ..= "W"
	elseif forward < 0 then
		chord ..= "S"
	end
	if lateral < 0 then
		chord ..= "A"
	elseif lateral > 0 then
		chord ..= "D"
	end
	if chord == "" then
		chord = "NONE"
	end

	if forward == 0 and lateral == 0 then
		return Vector3.zero, chord, forward
	end

	-- In camera space:
	-- -Z is forward (W), +Z is backward (S)
	-- -X is left (A), +X is right (D)
	local rawLocalVector = Vector3.new(lateral, 0, -forward)
	if rawLocalVector.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return Vector3.zero, chord, forward
	end

	return rawLocalVector.Unit, chord, forward
end

local function computeWorldDirection(camYaw: number): (Vector3, string, number)
	local localVec, chord, forward = computeLocalInputVector()
	if localVec.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return Vector3.zero, chord, forward
	end
	if goalDirection then
		return DribbleControlRules.GoalMovement(localVec, goalDirection), chord, forward
	end
	local yawRotation = CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0)
	local worldVec = (yawRotation:VectorToWorldSpace(localVec)).Unit
	return worldVec, chord, forward
end

local function checkIsAirborne(): boolean
	local nativeAirborne = false
	if currentHumanoid and currentHumanoid.Parent then
		local state = currentHumanoid:GetState()
		nativeAirborne = (state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end
	local airCtrl = getAirMovementController()
	local ctrlAirborne = (airCtrl ~= nil and airCtrl.IsAirborne ~= nil and airCtrl.IsAirborne() == true)
	return nativeAirborne or ctrlAirborne
end

local function isEligibleGrounded(): boolean
	local hum = currentHumanoid
	local hrp = currentHrp
	local char = currentCharacter
	if not hum or not hrp or not char or not hum.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local state = hum:GetState()

	-- Native airborne states are never eligible grounded
	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		return false
	end

	-- AirMovementController airborne state is never eligible grounded
	local airCtrl = getAirMovementController()
	if airCtrl and airCtrl.IsAirborne and airCtrl.IsAirborne() == true then
		return false
	end

	-- Unsupported / specialized locomotion states: do NOT force camera yaw or ground movement
	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
		or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
		or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
		or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
		or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
		or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
		return false
	end

	-- Must be on solid ground (non-air floor material), OR in Landed state
	if hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

local function updateMovementIntent(camYaw: number)
	goalDirection = nil
	if isGHeld and isEligibleGrounded() and currentCharacter and currentHrp then
		local goal = currentCharacter:GetAttribute("AttackGoalPosition")
		if typeof(goal) == "Vector3" then
			local direction = DribbleControlRules.HorizontalDirection(goal - currentHrp.Position)
			if direction.Magnitude > 0 then goalDirection = direction end
		end
	end
	local activeGoal = goalDirection ~= nil
	local now = os.clock()
	if currentCharacter and (activeGoal ~= lastGoalIntent or (activeGoal and now - lastGoalSentTime >= DribbleActionConfigs.INTENT_INTERVAL)) then
		local remote = getBallActionRemote()
		if remote then
			remote:FireServer({action = "GoalDribble", active = activeGoal, character = currentCharacter})
			lastGoalIntent = activeGoal
			lastGoalSentTime = now
		end
	end
	local worldDir, chord, forward = computeWorldDirection(camYaw)
	rawWorldDirection = worldDir
	currentChord = chord
	publishLeanInput(worldDir)

	currentWorldDirection = worldDir
	local char = currentCharacter
	if char and char:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") == true and isEligibleGrounded() then
		local opposingKeys = (isWDown and isSDown) or (isADown and isDDown)
		if opposingKeys then
			DribbleCutController.Cancel()
			lastCutInput = Vector3.zero
			lastCutWorldDir = Vector3.zero
			lastCutChord = "NONE"
			currentWorldDirection = Vector3.zero
		else
			local input = computeLocalInputVector()
			local locked = DribbleCutController.IsLocked(char)
			local sprintCtrl = getSprintController()
			local sprintingNow = (char:GetAttribute("IsSprinting") == true)
				or (sprintCtrl ~= nil and sprintCtrl.IsSprinting ~= nil and sprintCtrl.IsSprinting() == true)
			local cutsAllowed = sprintingNow and not activeGoal and (char:GetAttribute("GoalDribbleActive") ~= true)
			if not cutsAllowed and locked then
				DribbleCutController.Cancel()
				locked = false
			end
			if input.Magnitude > 0 then
				if now - lastCutInputTime > DribbleActionConfigs.REVERSE_INPUT_GRACE_SEC then
					lastCutInput = Vector3.zero
					lastCutWorldDir = Vector3.zero
					lastCutChord = "NONE"
				end
				if not locked and cutsAllowed then
					local name = DribbleControlRules.CutForTransition(lastCutChord, chord, lastCutInput, input, DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_REVERSE_ANGLE_DEG)
					local prevWorldDir = if lastCutWorldDir.Magnitude > 0.001
						then lastCutWorldDir
						elseif lastCutInput.Magnitude > 0.001
							then (CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(lastCutInput)).Unit
						else worldDir

					-- Mouse-steer cut detection: if holding the same key (e.g. W) and turning the mouse/camera so desired
					-- world direction diverges significantly from the current body heading, trigger the matching diagonal/reverse cut!
					local cutCooldown = DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_COOLDOWN_SEC or 0.20
					if not name and currentHrp and (now - lastCutEndTime >= cutCooldown) then
						local bodyLook = DribbleControlRules.HorizontalDirection(currentHrp.CFrame.LookVector)
						if bodyLook.Magnitude > 0.001 and worldDir.Magnitude > 0.001 then
							local steerAngleDeg = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(bodyLook:Dot(worldDir), -1, 1)))
							local crossY = bodyLook:Cross(worldDir).Y -- > 0 means steering Left, < 0 means steering Right
							local frontThresh = DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_MOUSE_STEER_DIAG_FRONT_DEG or 34
							local backThresh = DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_MOUSE_STEER_DIAG_BACK_DEG or 88
							local revThresh = DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_REVERSE_ANGLE_DEG or 120
							if steerAngleDeg >= revThresh then
								name = if crossY < 0 then "ReverseRight" else "ReverseLeft"
								prevWorldDir = bodyLook
							elseif steerAngleDeg >= backThresh then
								name = if crossY >= 0 then "BackLeft" else "BackRight"
								prevWorldDir = bodyLook
							elseif steerAngleDeg >= frontThresh then
								name = if crossY >= 0 then "FrontLeft" else "FrontRight"
								prevWorldDir = bodyLook
							end
						end
					end

					if not name and lastCutChord == "NONE" and #chord == 2 then
						name = if input.Z < 0
							then (if input.X < 0 then "FrontLeft" else "FrontRight")
							else (if input.X < 0 then "BackLeft" else "BackRight")
					end
					if name then
						locked = DribbleCutController.TryStart(char, name, worldDir, prevWorldDir)
						if locked then
							lastCutEndTime = now
						end
					end
				end
				-- Latest held input wins when the real animation finishes, without replay.
				lastCutChord = chord
				lastCutInput = input
				lastCutWorldDir = worldDir
				lastCutInputTime = now
			end
			-- While a cut animation is active, lock the carrier's travel direction to the cut's diagonal/exit direction
			-- at full normal speed until ControlRelease; once ControlRelease is reached, seamlessly steer into the running loop.
			if locked and not DribbleCutController.IsControlReleased(char) then
				local lockedDir = DribbleCutController.GetActiveCutDirection()
				if lockedDir and lockedDir.Magnitude > 0.001 then
					currentWorldDirection = lockedDir
				end
			end
		end
	else
		DribbleCutController.Cancel()
		lastCutInput = Vector3.zero
		lastCutWorldDir = Vector3.zero
		lastCutChord = "NONE"
		lastCutEndTime = now
	end

	local isMoving = currentWorldDirection.Magnitude > 0.001
	notifyMovementIntent(isMoving and not activeGoal, forward)
end

local function getShortestAngleDiff(target: number, current: number): number
	return (target - current + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
end

local function updateGroundedFacing(camYaw: number, dt: number): number
	local hrp = currentHrp
	local hum = currentHumanoid
	if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return 1.0
	end

	-- Ensure AutoRotate is false so native Humanoid does NOT rotate body toward MoveDirection
	if hum.AutoRotate then
		hum.AutoRotate = false
	end

	-- If stationary, maintain current heading; do NOT auto-align to reticle
	if currentWorldDirection.Magnitude <= 0.001 and not goalDirection then
		return 1.0
	end
	-- Cut no longer freezes heading: the body keeps turning toward the held direction while the cut clip plays.

	-- Ground body faces actual movement direction in 360°
	local facing = goalDirection or currentWorldDirection
	local targetYaw = math.atan2(-facing.X, -facing.Z)

	local rx, currentYaw, rz = hrp.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local diff = getShortestAngleDiff(targetYaw, currentYaw)
	local deadband = CameraPreviewConfigs.Movement.GroundedFacingDeadbandRad or 0.001

	local speedDipFactor = 1.0
	local movementCfg = CameraPreviewConfigs.Movement

	-- Dribbling carrier ONLY (valid grounded carrier): configurable turn slow-down, immediate drop, smooth recovery.
	-- No contact/phase/timer gate: the heading above always follows the latest intent immediately.
	local char = currentCharacter
	local isCarrier = (char and char:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") == true)
	if isCarrier then
		local isSprinting = (char:GetAttribute("IsSprinting") == true)
		local target = DribbleGeometryHelper.ComputeTurnSpeedFactor(diff, isSprinting)
		if target < dribbleTurnFactor then
			dribbleTurnFactor = target
		else
			dribbleTurnFactor = math.min(target, dribbleTurnFactor + DribbleConfigs.DRIBBLE_TURN_RECOVERY_RATE * math.clamp(dt, 0.001, 0.1))
		end
		local blocked = char:GetAttribute("DribbleSpeedFactor")
		local blockedFactor = if typeof(blocked) == "number" then math.clamp(blocked, 0, 1) else 1.0
		-- Diagonal turns (< 120 deg) and active dribble cuts keep full 1.0 speed (no speed dip on diagonal keyboard or mouse steering).
		if DribbleCutController.IsLocked(char) then
			dribbleTurnFactor = 1.0
			speedDipFactor = blockedFactor
		else
			speedDipFactor = dribbleTurnFactor * blockedFactor
		end
	elseif movementCfg and movementCfg.TurnSpeedDipEnabled ~= false then
		local threshRad = math.rad(movementCfg.TurnSpeedDipThresholdDeg or 30.0)
		local absDiff = math.abs(diff)
		if absDiff > threshRad then
			local minFactor = movementCfg.TurnSpeedDipMinFactor or 0.65
			local norm = math.clamp((absDiff - threshRad) / (math.pi - threshRad), 0, 1)
			speedDipFactor = 1.0 - (1.0 - minFactor) * (norm ^ 1.5)
		end
		dribbleTurnFactor = 1.0
	else
		dribbleTurnFactor = 1.0
	end

	if math.abs(diff) > deadband or math.abs(rx) > 0.02 or math.abs(rz) > 0.02 then
		local newYaw = targetYaw
		if movementCfg and movementCfg.TurnSmoothingEnabled ~= false then
			local turnSpeed = if isCarrier
				then (DribbleConfigs.DRIBBLE_TURN_RATE_RAD_PER_SEC or 10.0)
				else (movementCfg.FacingTurnSpeedRadPerSec or 20.0)
			local clampedDt = math.clamp(dt, 0.001, 0.1)
			local maxStep = turnSpeed * clampedDt
			if math.abs(diff) <= maxStep then
				newYaw = targetYaw
			else
				newYaw = currentYaw + math.sign(diff) * maxStep
			end
		end

		local curVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, newYaw, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = curVel
	end

	return speedDipFactor
end

local function resetAllKeys()
	isWDown = false
	isSDown = false
	isADown = false
	isDDown = false
	isSpaceDown = false
	isGHeld = false
	goalDirection = nil
	DribbleCutController.Cancel()
	lastCutChord = "NONE"
	lastCutInput = Vector3.zero
	lastCutWorldDir = Vector3.zero
	if lastGoalIntent then
		local remote = getBallActionRemote()
		if remote and currentCharacter then
			remote:FireServer({action = "GoalDribble", active = false, character = currentCharacter})
		end
	end
	lastGoalIntent = false
	lastGoalSentTime = 0
	jumpBufferUntil = 0
	dribbleTurnFactor = 1.0
	cutSpeedScale = 1.0
	currentChord = "NONE"
	rawWorldDirection = Vector3.zero
	currentWorldDirection = Vector3.zero
	publishLeanInput(Vector3.zero)
	notifyMovementIntent(false, 0)

	if currentHumanoid and currentHumanoid.Parent then
		currentHumanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
	end
end

local function onInputBegan(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if not isActive then
		return
	end
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end

	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.W or key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
		isWDown = true
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.S or key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
		isSDown = true
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.A or key == Enum.KeyCode.Left then
		isADown = true
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.D or key == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
		isDDown = true
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.G then
		isGHeld = true
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
		isSpaceDown = true
		jumpBufferUntil = os.clock() + JumpConfigs.JUMP_BUFFER_WINDOW_SEC
	end
end

local function onInputEnded(input: InputObject, _gameProcessed: boolean)
	if not isActive then
		return
	end

	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.W or key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
		isWDown = false
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.S or key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
		isSDown = false
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.A or key == Enum.KeyCode.Left then
		isADown = false
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.D or key == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
		isDDown = false
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.G then
		isGHeld = false
		updateMovementIntent(getCameraYaw())
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
		isSpaceDown = false
	end
end

local function onMovementStep(dt: number)
	if not isActive then
		return
	end

	if not currentHumanoid or not currentHumanoid.Parent then
		return
	end

	if currentHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local camYaw = getCameraYaw()
	updateMovementIntent(camYaw)

	local isAirborne = checkIsAirborne()
	if isAirborne then
		-- Humanoid air physics must not see a non-zero MoveDirection: AirMovementController owns
		-- airborne horizontal momentum/lean. Lean intent is delivered via publishLeanInput().
		currentHumanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
		-- Landing-edge jump buffer is preserved: do not clear jumpBufferUntil here
	elseif isEligibleGrounded() then
		-- Grounded: 360° Analog Locomotion Facing with Turn Smoothing & Speed Dip
		local speedDipFactor = updateGroundedFacing(camYaw, dt)
		if goalDirection then
			speedDipFactor *= math.min(1, DribbleActionConfigs.GOAL_SPEED / math.max(1, currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed))
		end

		-- Dribble cut: keep moving at reduced speed for the cut, then recover smoothly.
		local cutLocked = currentCharacter ~= nil and DribbleCutController.IsLocked(currentCharacter)
		if cutLocked then
			local cutName = DribbleCutController.GetActiveCutName()
			local cutFactor = if cutName ~= nil and CUT_REVERSE_NAMES[cutName]
				then DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_MOVE_SPEED_FACTOR_REVERSE
				else DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_MOVE_SPEED_FACTOR
			cutSpeedScale = math.min(cutFactor, DribbleCutController.GetMovementSpeedFactor())
		else
			cutSpeedScale = math.min(1.0, cutSpeedScale + DribbleActionConfigs.CUT_SPEED_RECOVERY_PER_SEC * dt)
		end
		speedDipFactor = math.min(speedDipFactor, cutSpeedScale)

		-- Apply camera-relative movement direction while grounded, scaled by turn speed dip factor
		if currentWorldDirection.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			currentHumanoid:Move(currentWorldDirection * speedDipFactor, false)
		else
			currentHumanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
		end

		local state = currentHumanoid:GetState()
		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			jumpBufferUntil = 0
		elseif (isSpaceDown or os.clock() < jumpBufferUntil)
			and not (currentCharacter and DribbleCutController.IsLocked(currentCharacter)) then
			-- A press on the Landed edge would otherwise be eaten by Landed -> Running
			if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed and currentHumanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
				currentHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			else
				currentHumanoid.Jump = true
			end
		end
	else
		-- Unsupported state (Seated, Climbing, Swimming, Physics, Ragdoll, etc.)
		-- Hands off without forcing camera yaw or overriding native movement.
		if not currentHumanoid.AutoRotate then
			currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
		end
		publishLeanInput(Vector3.zero)
	end

	if currentCharacter then
		currentCharacter:SetAttribute("MovePreviewActive", true)
		currentCharacter:SetAttribute("CurrentMoveDirection", currentWorldDirection)
		currentCharacter:SetAttribute("DesiredMoveDirection", rawWorldDirection)
		currentCharacter:SetAttribute("LatchedMoveDirection", currentWorldDirection)

		-- Report validated camera look intent when player is the active ball carrier
		if currentCharacter:GetAttribute("IsBallCarrier") == true then
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastSentCameraIntent >= 0.1 then
				lastSentCameraIntent = now
				local camLook = Vector3.new(-math.sin(camYaw), 0, -math.cos(camYaw))
				local remote = getBallActionRemote()
				if remote then
					pcall(function()
						remote:FireServer({
							action = "CameraIntent",
							lookDirection = camLook,
						})
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setupCharacter(char: Model)
	currentCharacter = char
	currentHumanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5.0) :: Humanoid?
	currentHrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5.0) :: BasePart?

	resetAllKeys()

	if currentHumanoid then
		currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
		table.insert(
			connections,
			currentHumanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				resetAllKeys()
			end)
		)
	end
end

local function suspendNativeControls()
	task.spawn(function()
		local playerScripts = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 5.0) :: PlayerScripts?
		if not playerScripts then
			return
		end
		local playerModuleScript = playerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 5.0) :: ModuleScript?
		if not playerModuleScript then
			return
		end

		local ok, PlayerModule = pcall(require, playerModuleScript)
		if ok and typeof(PlayerModule) == "table" and PlayerModule.GetControls then
			nativeControls = PlayerModule:GetControls()
			if nativeControls and nativeControls.Disable then
				nativeControls:Disable()
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function restoreNativeControls()
	if nativeControls and nativeControls.Enable then
		pcall(function()
			nativeControls:Enable()
		end)
	end
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.GetCurrentDirection(): Vector3
	return currentWorldDirection
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.GetLatchedDirection(): Vector3
	return currentWorldDirection
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.GetCurrentChord(): string
	return currentChord
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.GetResolvedForward(): number
	return (isWDown and 1 or 0) - (isSDown and 1 or 0)
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.IsForwardEligible(): boolean
	return ((isWDown and 1 or 0) - (isSDown and 1 or 0)) > 0
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.GetDesiredDirection(): Vector3
	return rawWorldDirection
end

-- Touch-phase turn gate removed (Owner 2026-10-27): turns are never gated
function MovementHeadingPreviewController.IsTurnGated(): boolean
	return false
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.IsActive(): boolean
	return isActive
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.Init()
	if isInitialized then
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	if not CameraPreviewConfigs.IsActiveInCurrentContext() then
		return
	end
	if not CameraPreviewConfigs.Movement.Enabled then
		return
	end

	isActive = true

	-- Suspend native PlayerModule movement so custom camera-relative movement has sole control
	suspendNativeControls()
	local airCtrl = getAirMovementController()
	if airCtrl and airCtrl.SetLeanInputSourceEnabled then
		airCtrl.SetLeanInputSourceEnabled(true)
	end

	-- Input listeners
	table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan))
	table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(onInputEnded))

	-- Safety resets
	table.insert(
		connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			resetAllKeys()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		connections,
		UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
			resetAllKeys()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		connections,
		UserInputService.TextBoxFocused:Connect(function()
			resetAllKeys()
		end)
	)

	-- Pre-physics movement application
	-- Bound AFTER native Humanoid input (RenderPriority.Input) and BEFORE physics, so native input
	-- cannot reset Humanoid.Jump / Move set here.
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(MOVEMENT_STEP_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 5, onMovementStep)

	-- Character tracking
	if localPlayer.Character then
		setupCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
	end
	table.insert(
		connections,
		localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
			setupCharacter(newChar)
		end)
	)
end

function MovementHeadingPreviewController.Cleanup()
	isActive = false
	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(MOVEMENT_STEP_NAME)
	end)

	resetAllKeys()
	local airCtrl = getAirMovementController()
	if airCtrl and airCtrl.SetLeanInputSourceEnabled then
		airCtrl.SetLeanInputSourceEnabled(false)
	end
	restoreNativeControls()

	if currentHumanoid and currentHumanoid.Parent then
		currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)

	currentCharacter = nil
	currentHumanoid = nil
	currentHrp = nil
	nativeControls = nil
	ballActionRemoteRef = nil
	lastSentCameraIntent = 0
	isInitialized = false
end

return MovementHeadingPreviewController
